name: NCAA D-I West Regional Cross Country Championships
headline: NCAA D-I West Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Men: No. 5 Oregon, No. 19 Stanford and No. 27 Arizona. Women: No. 11 Oregon, No. 17 Washington State and No. 26 Washington. The top two teams and the top four individuals not on those teams qualify automatically for the NCAA Championships on Nov. 21. · Women 6K · Men 10K
